subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should the Copilot BYOK proxy adopt a hard 16 MiB request-body cap and 30 second body-read timeout for existing users?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and proven, but the chosen cap changes the accepted request envelope for an existing local provider proxy path and the repo policy treats provider fallback and fail-closed behavior as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept the bounded proxy contract
options.body: Treat 16 MiB and 30 seconds as the intended Copilot BYOK proxy limit now that normal forwarding and oversized rejection have terminal proof and a focused test.

options.title: Adjust the envelope before merge
options.body: Change the constants if maintainers expect valid Copilot BYOK SDK requests above 16 MiB or reads longer than 30 seconds, while keeping the shared limiter shape.

options.title: Pause for payload confirmation
options.body: Hold the PR until the expected Copilot BYOK request-size envelope is confirmed if maintainers do not want a new hard rejection contract yet.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded proxy contract
recommendation.body: Treat 16 MiB and 30 seconds as the intended Copilot BYOK proxy limit now that normal forwarding and oversized rejection have terminal proof and a focused test.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the BYOK provider parity path that owns this proxy behavior.
